marketing_manager.headline: Placement year, then eighteen months in
marketing_manager.why: An early marketing CV is judged on whether you can carry one campaign end to end — brief, budget, agency, readout — not on how many channels you have touched. Two campaigns with real money attached beat a list of ten tools, and the placement year is written up as a job because that is what it was.

customer_success.headline: Ten years, runs retention for the business
customer_success.why: At director level the CV is answering whether you can hold a retention number across a whole customer base, so it names the book, the team and the segmentation decisions rather than individual accounts. Note the bullet on gross retention: net is easy to flatter with expansion, and senior interviewers go looking for the harder number first.
